Frequently Asked Questions

How do I fill the UG exam form for Wazirganj College?

Magadh University student login portal: magadhonline.in / magadhonline.com

What is the last date for the Sem-III (2025-29) exam form?

The portal for the Sem-III (U.G. Session 2025-29) exam form closed on 23/11/2026 at 3:00 PM. The Admit Card will be issued next.

What is the last date for the Sem-V (2024-28) exam form?

The last date for the Sem-V (U.G. Session 2024-28) exam form is 05/12/2026.

What is the last date for the Sem-VII (2023-27) exam form?

Magadh University (Memo No. CEO/1119/2026, दिनांक 21/11/2026) ke anusaar Sem-VII (U.G. Session 2023-27) ke students apna Exam Form online bharein — User ID aur Password se, fee ₹800. University ne abhi koi nayi Last Date ghoshit nahi ki hai.

Where can I check my Magadh University result and download my marksheet?

Magadh University result portal — Result / Marksheet links are given on your U.G. Session page. Registration No. and Exam Roll No. required.

🎓 Admission Form — Required Details

EdMitr Portal पर Admission Form भरने से पहले नीचे दी गई जानकारी और Documents तैयार रखें।

Admission Portal

Apply kaise karein — Step by Step

  • Step 1: EdMitr Admission Portal kholein aur login karein।
  • Step 2: Admission Form me apni details bharein (neeche checklist ke anusaar)।
  • Step 3: Previous Admit Card (PDF, 1 MB se kam) upload karein।
  • Step 4: Form submit karein aur receipt save karke rakhein।

Merit list aane par apne session ke page aur Notice Board par check karein।

1. Student Details

  • Aadhaar Number
  • APAAR ID
  • Caste Category

2. Parent Details

  • Father/Parent Name
  • Parent's Aadhaar Number

3. Address Details

  • Village/Post
  • Police Station
  • District
  • PIN Code
  • State

4. Subject Details

  • MIC Subject Choice (जहाँ लागू हो)

5. Previous Academic Document

  • Previous Admit Card
  • PDF format
  • File size: Less than 1 MB

6. Bank Details

  • Bank Name
  • Branch
  • Account Number
  • IFSC Code
Note: Requirements may differ by session. The college notice and admission-form instructions for your session are final — please follow those instructions for your session.

Note: Fill only the required information. Last date is as per each session's college notice — check the latest notice on the website before going.

Fill Exam Form — Magadh University

Magadh University Student Dashboard के माध्यम से Exam Form भरें। Form भरने से पहले नीचे दी गई जानकारी और Documents तैयार रखें।

Open Magadh University Student Dashboard www.magadhonline.in/student/dashboard

Login Details

User IDअपना Admit Card Number डालें। यह "23G00..." से शुरू होता है।
Passwordअपने नाम के पहले 4 letters CAPITAL में + Date of Birth (DDMMYYYY)
ExampleName: Veeru Verma · DOB: 11 May 2005 · Password:VEER11052005

⚠️ Login details किसी दूसरे व्यक्ति के साथ share न करें।

Exam Fee

Exam Form fee Rs. 800 hai — sabhi sessions/semesters ke liye. Fee online pay karein — UPI ya Debit/Credit Card se.

Exam Form भरने के लिए क्या चाहिए?

  • Previous Admit Card
  • Registration Number
  • Name & Date of Birth
  • Online Fee PaymentUPI · Debit/Credit Card
  • Filled Exam Form / Payment ReceiptForm submit करने के बाद receipt/printout सुरक्षित रखें।

Form kaise bharein — Step by Step

  • Step 1: Magadh University Student Dashboard kholein aur upar diye gaye User ID / Password se login karein।
  • Step 2: Dashboard me Exam Form ka option chunein।
  • Step 3: Apni details (naam, session, semester, subjects) check karein।
  • Step 4: Rs. 800 fee online pay karein (UPI / Debit / Credit Card)।
  • Step 5: Form submit karein aur Receipt / Printout save karke rakhein।

⚠️ Payment kat gaya lekin form submit nahi hua, to pehle Dashboard par payment / receipt status check karein — turant dobara payment na karein।

Form भरने से पहले

  • Dashboard में Exam Form का option दिखाई दे तो form भरें।
  • अगर Exam Form का option नहीं दिखाई दे रहा है, तो college validation/activation का इंतज़ार करें।
  • Form submit करने के बाद Receipt/Printout सुरक्षित रखें।
  • Last Date: अपने Session की latest college notice के अनुसार देखें।

Internship — Magadh University

Wazirganj College ke students ke liye Internship se judi zaroori jaankari — 4-credit Internship, poora timeline, Report jama aur Exam Date।

Report jama karein: Internship karne ke baad apni Report college karyalaya me jald-se-jald jama kar dein — warna Exam Form nahi bhar payenge। (Session 2023-27 aur 2024-28)

Internship kya hai — ek nazar me

  • NEP ke tahat 5th Semester me Internship anivarya hai — bina Internship poori kiye 5th Semester clear nahi hoga aur Degree valid nahi hogi।
  • 100 marks, 4 credits — BA, BSc aur BCom (General / ST / SC / OBC, sabhi ke liye, koi chhoot nahi)।
  • Kul 120 hours — 90 hours online training + 30 hours report writing; course duration 1.5–2.5 mahine; saari classes online hoti hain aur recordings milti hain।
  • Registration ke samay koi fee nahi; company dwara ₹199 Registration & Documentation Fee liya jata hai (learning programme ke roop me)।
  • Course ke baad portal se Report aur Certificate download karein, printout college me jama karein, phir Viva — Viva pass karne ke baad hi 5th Semester ka result jari hoga।

Ye jaankari 07/08/2026 ko college me hui meeting par based hai, kisi official notification par nahi।

4 Agencies — Registration Links

College notice (07/08/2026, MU letter CEO/910/2026) ke anusar in 4 agencies me se kisi ek me register karna tha — Registration 07/08/2026 se 14/08/2026 tak hua tha। Registration ki copy college / university ko jama karni thi।

  • IT Hub Solution
  • Vidyayan Skills Foundation
  • Chandra Educational World
  • Aruna Infotech

Note: College notice me 4th agency ka naam “M/s Amazecraft Creation Pvt. Ltd., Patna” likha hai, lekin link Aruna Infotech ka diya gaya hai।

Poora Timeline — August se December 2026

  • 07/08/2026 — College notice: Internship anivarya, bina iske Degree valid nahi; registration 07/08/2026 se 14/08/2026 tak। Post 2018
  • 07/08/2026 — College meeting: 100 marks, 4 credits, 120 hours, ₹199 fee, Viva ke baad result। Post 2015
  • 22/08/2026 — IT Hub Solution registration ki last date। Post 2035
  • 01/09/2026 — Online classes shuru: subah 7:30–9:30 AM aur shaam 4:00–6:00 PM, topic-wise (Digital Marketing, AI, Agriculture aadi subah; Art & Craft, Skill Development aadi shaam)। Post 2050
  • 22/09/2026 — IT Hub classes complete; certificate lagbhag 1 hafte me। Post 2100
  • 27/09/2026 — IT Hub Internship Certificate download ke liye available। Post 2107
  • 23/10/2026 — 4-Credit Internship poori karne ki last date (Session 2023-27)। Post 2120
  • 26/10/2026 – 05/11/2026 — College dwara Internship Marks University Portal par upload। Post 2120
  • 05/11/2026 — Internship Report college office me jald-se-jald jama karein (Session 2023-27 aur 2024-28) — warna Exam Form nahi bhar payenge। Post 2147
  • 15/12/2026 — Sem-V Internship Exam (Session 2024-28)।

5th Semester 4-Credit Internship (Session 2023-27)

  • Magadh University ke UG CBCS Session 2023-27 me 5th Semester me IKS ke sthan par ab 4-Credit Internship ki prakriya hai।
  • Internship 23/10/2026 tak poori karni thi।
  • Internship poori hone ke baad college dwara Internship Marks University Portal par upload kiye gaye — Marks Upload 26/10/2026 se 05/11/2026 tak hua।
  • 6th Semester ke baad UG Degree Exit lena hai to Internship poori hona aur Marks upload hona zaroori hai — tabhi Exit Option ke tahat praman patra milega।

Internship Report kaise jama karein

  • Step 1: Apni Internship poori karein।
  • Step 2: Internship Report taiyar karein।
  • Step 3: College aakar Report college karyalaya me jama kar dein।
  • Step 4: Jama karne ki receipt / confirmation le lein।

Ye suchna Session 2023-27 aur Session 2024-28 dono ke students ke liye hai। Report jama na karne par Exam Form bharne me dikkat hogi।

Sem-V Internship Exam

  • 15/12/2026 — Internship (Examination Programme, Semester-V, U.G. Session 2024-28)।

PMS Scholarship 2026-27 — Post-Matric Scholarship

Bihar Post-Matric Scholarship (PMS), shaikshanik satra 2026-27: BC-EBC aur SC-ST ke ve students jinhone pehle window me apply nahi kiya tha, ab apply kar sakte hain।

BC-EBC Portal SC-ST Portal
Last Date: 30/11/2026 — Portal 12/11/2026 se 30/11/2026 tak khula hai। Pehli window 15/07/2026 se 30/09/2026 tak thi।

Kaun apply kar sakta hai?

  • BC-EBC aur SC-ST category ke students।
  • Jo students kisi kaaran se pehli window (15/07/2026 – 30/09/2026) me apply nahi kar paye the।
  • Session 2026-27 me Wazirganj College me admission lene wale students।

Apply kaise karein — Step by Step

  • Step 1: Apni category ka portal kholein — BC-EBC ke liye pmsonline.bihar.gov.in, SC-ST ke liye scstpmsonline.bihar.gov.in।
  • Step 2: New Registration / Login karein।
  • Step 3: Application form me apni details bharein।
  • Step 4: Required documents upload karein।
  • Step 5: Form submit karein aur application receipt save karke rakhein।

Documents taiyar rakhein

  • Aadhaar Card
  • Caste Certificate
  • Income Certificate
  • Previous Class Marksheet / Admit Card
  • Bank Account Details (Passbook)
  • Admission Receipt / Bonafide Certificate

Portal par di gayi final document list hi maani jayegi — apply karne se pehle use check karein।

Useful Links

  • BC-EBC Portal — pmsonline.bihar.gov.in
  • SC-ST Portal — scstpmsonline.bihar.gov.in
  • Institute Portal — instpmsonline.bihar.gov.in
  • Full Notice — PMS Scholarship 2026-27 portal reopen notice।

Privacy Policy

How Wazirganj College Updates handles your information. Last updated: 21 November 2026.

Information we collect

  • Analytics: We use Vercel Analytics to see anonymous, aggregated usage — which pages students visit, device type and approximate region. It does not use cookies for tracking and does not collect your name, phone number, email, roll number or documents.
  • Notifications: If you allow notifications, OneSignal stores a subscription so we can send new-notice alerts. You can turn notifications off anytime in your browser settings.
  • No accounts: This website has no login or sign-up. We never ask for your password, OTP, roll number, Aadhaar number or bank details.
  • Messages: If you contact us on Telegram, WhatsApp or Instagram, we see only what you send us.
  • Donations: We do not accept donations.

Cookies and advertising

Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this website or other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visit to this site and/or other sites on the Internet. You may opt out of personalised advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings or www.aboutads.info/choices. Advertising may be shown on this website in the future; this section applies when it is.

How information is used and shared

Usage data helps us keep notices and last dates up to date and understand which pages students use. We do not sell personal information. Analytics and notification providers process data under their own privacy policies.

External links

This website links to the official Wazirganj College and Magadh University portals. Their privacy practices are their own.

Children's privacy

This website is meant for college students. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes to this policy

This policy may be updated when needed. The date at the top shows the latest version.

Contact

Questions about this policy? Reach us through the Contact page.

About Wazirganj College Updates

An independent student updates page for Wazirganj College, Wazirganj (Gaya).

What this website is

Wazirganj College Updates is an independent student updates page for Wazirganj College, Wazirganj (Gaya), affiliated to Magadh University, Bodh Gaya. It is run by Veeru Verma, a student of the college. This is not the official website of Wazirganj College or Magadh University.

What we publish

Exam form last dates, exam programmes, results and marksheets, admission updates, holidays and scholarships (such as PMS) — for U.G. sessions 2023-27, 2024-28, 2025-29 and 2026-30. Notices come from the college and Magadh University. Always verify dates and details on the official portals before acting.
